record.name: Modder
record.description: Modders are specialists in equipment modification and enhancement, using their skills to improve weapons, armor, and other gear beyond their original specifications.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Masters of equipment modification, pushing gear beyond its limits.

progression_tree.description: You gain expertise in one tool of your choice, and can use it to make adjustments to equipment modifications.
You gain access to advanced training in a tool or technology of your choice, allowing you to push the boundaries of equipment modification.
You develop a deep understanding of the intricacies of equipment modification, allowing you to create custom components and upgrade existing gear.
You learn advanced techniques for optimizing equipment performance, allowing you to squeeze out every last bit of power and efficiency.
You become a true master of equipment modification, able to craft and modify gear with unparalleled precision and skill.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a defensive stance with feet shoulder-width apart, lightsaber at the ready.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounded by a swirling aura of blue and red plasma, emanating from the hilt of their lightsaber.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A skilled Modder in their workshop, surrounded by various tools and equipment, with a critical expression on their face as they fine-tune a hyper-advanced blaster rifle.
contextual_modifiers: Show the blaster rifle's energy output at maximum capacity
Include a holographic display projecting schematics of the rifle's innards
